descripcion: BROAD STREET. El carretero de la fabrica de los Eley sube a Hampstead cada dia; lleva a Whitehead.

abre.texto: Up to Hampstead, Reverend? I go up every day for the family.

opciones.texto: Will you take me with you?
I need to see her house.

sube.texto: Climb up, then. Hold on tight, the road is bad.
